70struct ScriptPrimitive3D {
71 ScriptPrimitive3D(std::weak_ptr<PrimitiveScene> sceneValue, PrimitiveHandle handleValue)
72 : scene(std::move(sceneValue)), handle(handleValue) {}
73 ~ScriptPrimitive3D() noexcept {
74 if (auto owner = scene.lock(); owner && !owner->isStale(handle))
75 owner->remove(handle).ignore("script primitive proxy destruction");
76 }
77
78 std::weak_ptr<PrimitiveScene> scene;
79 PrimitiveHandle handle;
80};

82template <class T>
83eve::Result<T> primitiveBindingFailure(eve::DiagnosticCode code, std::string message, std::string path) {
84 return eve::Result<T>::failure(
85 eve::Diagnostic::error(code, std::move(message), std::move(path), {}, "graphics.primitive.binding"));
86}

88eve::Result<PrimitiveDescriptor3D> primitiveDescriptor(ScriptPrimitive3D* value) {
89 if (!value)
90 return primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveDescriptor3D>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
91 "primitive proxy must not be null", "primitive");
92 auto scene = value->scene.lock();
93 if (!scene)
94 return primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveDescriptor3D>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
95 "primitive scene owner no longer exists", "primitive");
96 const PrimitiveDescriptor3D* descriptor = scene->tryGet(value->handle);
97 if (!descriptor)
98 return primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveDescriptor3D>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
99 "primitive handle is stale", "primitive");
100 return eve::Result<PrimitiveDescriptor3D>::success(*descriptor);
101}
102
103template <class Mutator>
104eve::Result<PrimitiveUpdateStatus> mutatePrimitive(ScriptPrimitive3D* value, Mutator&& mutator) {
105 auto descriptor = primitiveDescriptor(value);
106 if (!descriptor) return eve::Result<PrimitiveUpdateStatus>::failure(descriptor.status());
107 PrimitiveDescriptor3D copy = std::move(descriptor).takeValue();
108 std::invoke(std::forward<Mutator>(mutator), copy);
109 auto scene = value->scene.lock();
110 if (!scene)
111 return primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveUpdateStatus>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
112 "primitive scene owner no longer exists", "primitive");
113 return scene->update(value->handle, std::move(copy));
114}

116ssq::Table makePrimitiveProxy(HSQUIRRELVM vm, const std::shared_ptr<PrimitiveScene>& scene,
117 eve::Result<PrimitiveHandle>&& result) {
118 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, result.status(), false, false);
119 const PrimitiveHandle handle = std::move(result).takeValue();
120 auto object = eve::script::makeOwnedSquirrelInstance<ScriptPrimitive3D>(
121 vm, std::make_unique<ScriptPrimitive3D>(scene, handle));
122 if (!object) {
123 const eve::Status status = object.status();
124 object.ignore("failed to create owned primitive proxy");
125 scene->remove(handle).ignore("rollback failed primitive proxy allocation");
126 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
127 }
128 auto projected = eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, eve::Status::success(eve::StatusCode::Applied), true, false);
129 projected.set("value", std::move(object).takeValue());
130 projected.set("ownership", std::string("owned"));
131 projected.set("owner", static_cast<std::int64_t>(handle.owner()));
132 projected.set("index", static_cast<std::int64_t>(handle.index()));
133 projected.set("generation", static_cast<std::int64_t>(handle.generation()));
134 return projected;
135}

146bool copyArrayFloats(ssq::Array arr, std::vector<float> &out) {
147 const size_t n = arr.size();
148 out.resize(n);
149 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) out[i] = arr.get<float>(i);
150 return n > 0;
151}

153bool copyArrayUints(ssq::Array arr, std::vector<uint32_t> &out) {
154 const size_t n = arr.size();
155 out.resize(n);
156 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) out[i] = static_cast<uint32_t>(arr.get<int>(i));
157 return n > 0;
158}

160Mesh *newMeshFromArraysScript(Graphics *gfx, ssq::Array posArr, ssq::Array nrmArr,
161 ssq::Array uvArr, int vertexCount, ssq::Array idxArr,
162 int indexCount) {
163 std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv;
164 std::vector<uint32_t> idx;
165 copyArrayFloats(posArr, pos);
166 copyArrayFloats(nrmArr, nrm);
167 copyArrayFloats(uvArr, uv);
168 copyArrayUints(idxArr, idx);
169 return gfx->newMeshFromArrays(pos.data(), nrm.empty() ? nullptr : nrm.data(),
170 uv.empty() ? nullptr : uv.data(), vertexCount,
171 idx.empty() ? nullptr : idx.data(), indexCount);

265Shader* Graphics::prepareSceneColorResolveShader(Texture* scene) {
266 if (!scene) return nullptr;
267 AntiAliasing* aa = pipelineAntiAliasing();
268 const bool doAA = !renderControl_ || renderControl_->isEnabled("aa") || renderControl_->isEnabled("taa");
269 aa->setMode("fxaa");
270 if (doAA) {
271 const std::string requested =
272 renderControl_ ? renderControl_->getPostProcessQuality() : "high";
273 const std::string quality = requested == "ultra" ? "high" : requested;
274 if (aa->getQuality() != quality) aa->setQuality(quality);
275 } else {
276 if (aa->getMode() == "fxaa") {
277 aa->setFloat("edgeThreshold", 1.f);
278 aa->setFloat("edgeThresholdMin", 1.f);
279 aa->setFloat("subpix", 0.f);
280 }
281 }
282 aa->prepareSource(scene);
283 return aa->getShader();
284}

286void Graphics::drawScene3DRGBA(float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float g, float b, float a) {
287 Texture* scene = getSceneColorTexture();
288 if (!scene) return;
289 // Scene color A is linear view-depth, not opacity. The default textured
290 // blit multiplies that into SrcAlpha, so the planet composites against
291 // the dark clear color and looks dim. Use the same opaque FXAA resolve
292 // as the engine auto-composite path (aa shader writes alpha = 1).
293 Texture *resolved = prepareFinalSceneTexture(scene);
294 drawTexturedRectShaderUV(resolved, nullptr, x, y, w, h, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f,
295 Color(r, g, b, a), false, BlendMode::Opaque);
296}

320void Graphics::expose(ssq::Table& table) {
321 auto cls = table.addClass(name, Graphics::create, false);
322 expose(cls);
323 const auto vm = table.getHandle();
324
325 auto primitive = table.addClass<ScriptPrimitive3D>(
326 "Primitive3D", std::function<ScriptPrimitive3D*()>([]() { return nullptr; }), false);
327 primitive.addFunc("ownership", [](ScriptPrimitive3D*) { return std::string("owned"); });
328 primitive.addFunc("isStale", [](ScriptPrimitive3D* value) {
329 if (!value) return true;
330 auto scene = value->scene.lock();
331 return !scene || scene->isStale(value->handle);
332 });
333 primitive.addFunc("remove", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value) {
334 if (!value)
335 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
336 vm,
337 primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveRemoveStatus>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
338 "primitive proxy must not be null", "primitive")
339 .status(),
340 false, false);
341 auto scene = value->scene.lock();
342 if (!scene)
343 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
344 vm,
345 primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveRemoveStatus>(eve::DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
346 "primitive scene owner no longer exists", "primitive")
347 .status(),
348 false, false);
349 auto result = scene->remove(value->handle);
350 const eve::Status status = result.status();
351 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
352 std::move(result).takeValue();
353 value->handle = {};
354 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
355 });
356 primitive.addFunc("setVisible", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, bool visible) {
357 auto result =
358 mutatePrimitive(value, [visible](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) { descriptor.visible = visible; });
359 const eve::Status status = result.status();
360 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
361 std::move(result).takeValue();
362 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
363 });
364 primitive.addFunc("setColor", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, float r, float g, float b, float a) {
365 auto result = mutatePrimitive(
366 value, [=](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) { descriptor.paint.color = Color(r, g, b, a); });
367 const eve::Status status = result.status();
368 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
369 std::move(result).takeValue();
370 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
371 });
372 primitive.addFunc("setLineWidth", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, float width) {
373 auto result = mutatePrimitive(
374 value, [width](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) { descriptor.paint.stroke.width = width; });
375 const eve::Status status = result.status();
376 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
377 std::move(result).takeValue();
378 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
379 });
380 primitive.addFunc("setDash", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, float drawLength, float gapLength, float phase,
381 const std::string& space) {
382 if (space != "screen" && space != "world")
383 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
384 vm,
385 primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveUpdateStatus>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
386 "dash space must be screen or world", "dashSpace")
387 .status(),
388 false, false);
389 auto result = mutatePrimitive(value, [=](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) {
390 DashPattern dash;
391 dash.intervals = {drawLength, gapLength};
392 dash.phase = phase;
393 dash.space = space == "screen" ? DashSpace::ScreenPixels : DashSpace::WorldUnits;
394 descriptor.paint.stroke.dash = std::move(dash);
395 });
396 const eve::Status status = result.status();
397 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
398 std::move(result).takeValue();
399 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
400 });
401 primitive.addFunc("clearDash", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value) {
402 auto result =
403 mutatePrimitive(value, [](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) { descriptor.paint.stroke.dash.reset(); });
404 const eve::Status status = result.status();
405 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
406 std::move(result).takeValue();
407 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
408 });
409 primitive.addFunc("setDepthMode", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, const std::string& mode) {
410 std::optional<PrimitiveDepthMode> parsed;
411 if (mode == "test-write")
412 parsed = PrimitiveDepthMode::TestAndWrite;
413 else if (mode == "test")
414 parsed = PrimitiveDepthMode::TestOnly;
415 else if (mode == "ignore")
416 parsed = PrimitiveDepthMode::Ignore;
417 if (!parsed)
418 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
419 vm,
420 primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveUpdateStatus>(
421 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "depth mode must be test-write, test, or ignore", "depthMode")
422 .status(),
423 false, false);
424 auto result = mutatePrimitive(
425 value, [mode = *parsed](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) { descriptor.paint.depth = mode; });
426 const eve::Status status = result.status();
427 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
428 std::move(result).takeValue();
429 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
430 });
431 primitive.addFunc("setObjectId", [vm](ScriptPrimitive3D* value, std::int64_t objectId) {
432 if (objectId < 0)
433 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(
434 vm,
435 primitiveBindingFailure<PrimitiveUpdateStatus>(eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
436 "object id must be non-negative", "objectId")
437 .status(),
438 false, false);
439 auto result = mutatePrimitive(value, [objectId](PrimitiveDescriptor3D& descriptor) {
440 descriptor.paint.objectId = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(objectId);
441 });
442 const eve::Status status = result.status();
443 if (!result) return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, false, false);
444 std::move(result).takeValue();
445 return eve::script::projectStatusResult(vm, status, true, false);
446 });

1446Texture* Graphics::prepareFinalSceneTexture(Texture *scene, Texture *motion) {
1447 if (!scene) return nullptr;
1448 Texture *resolved = scene;
1449 AntiAliasing *aa = pipelineAntiAliasing();
1450 const bool temporal = renderControl_ && renderControl_->isEnabled("taa");
1451 const bool spatial = !renderControl_ || renderControl_->isEnabled("aa");
1452 const std::string requested = renderControl_ ? renderControl_->getPostProcessQuality() : "high";
1453 const std::string quality = requested == "ultra" ? "high" : requested;
1454 if (aa->getQuality() != quality) aa->setQuality(quality);
1455 if (temporal) {
1456 aa->setMode("taa");
1457 resolved = aa->resolveTemporal(this, scene, motion);
1458 } else if (spatial) {
1459 aa->setMode("fxaa");
1460 const int width = std::max(scene->getWidth(), 1);
1461 const int height = std::max(scene->getHeight(), 1);
1462 if (!spatialAAResolve_ || spatialAAResolveWidth_ != width ||
1463 spatialAAResolveHeight_ != height) {
1464 spatialAAResolve_ = newHDRCanvas(width, height);
1465 spatialAAResolveWidth_ = width;
1466 spatialAAResolveHeight_ = height;
1467 }
1468 aa->applyTo(this, scene, spatialAAResolve_);
1469 resolved = spatialAAResolve_->getTexture();
1470 }
1471 Texture *meterSource = resolved;
1472 resolved = pipelineBloom()->apply(resolved, getSceneBloomIntensity(),
1473 getSceneBloomThreshold());
1474 return pipelineExposure()->apply(resolved, getSceneExposure(), getSceneAutoExposure(),
1475 getSceneAutoExposureMinEV(), getSceneAutoExposureMaxEV(),
1476 meterSource);
1477}

1519Mesh* Graphics::newMeshCube(float size) {
1520 const float h = size * 0.5f;
1521 // 6 faces x 4 corners (per-face normal + full 0..1 UV), outward CCW for RH Y-up.
1522 const float kFaces[6][4][3] = {
1523 {{-h, -h, h}, {h, -h, h}, {h, h, h}, {-h, h, h}}, // +Z
1524 {{h, -h, -h}, {-h, -h, -h}, {-h, h, -h}, {h, h, -h}}, // -Z
1525 {{h, -h, h}, {h, -h, -h}, {h, h, -h}, {h, h, h}}, // +X
1526 {{-h, -h, -h}, {-h, -h, h}, {-h, h, h}, {-h, h, -h}}, // -X
1527 {{-h, h, h}, {h, h, h}, {h, h, -h}, {-h, h, -h}}, // +Y
1528 {{-h, -h, -h}, {h, -h, -h}, {h, -h, h}, {-h, -h, h}}, // -Y
1529 };
1530 const float kN[6][3] = {{0, 0, 1}, {0, 0, -1}, {1, 0, 0}, {-1, 0, 0}, {0, 1, 0}, {0, -1, 0}};
1531 const float kUV[4][2] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {0, 1}};
1532
1533 std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv;
1534 pos.reserve(6 * 4 * 3);
1535 nrm.reserve(6 * 4 * 3);
1536 uv.reserve(6 * 4 * 2);
1537 std::vector<uint32_t> indices;
1538 indices.reserve(6 * 6);
1539 for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {
1540 const uint32_t base = uint32_t(f * 4);
1541 for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
1542 pos.insert(pos.end(), kFaces[f][c], kFaces[f][c] + 3);
1543 nrm.insert(nrm.end(), kN[f], kN[f] + 3);
1544 uv.insert(uv.end(), kUV[c], kUV[c] + 2);
1545 }
1546 indices.push_back(base + 0);
1547 indices.push_back(base + 1);
1548 indices.push_back(base + 2);
1549 indices.push_back(base + 0);
1550 indices.push_back(base + 2);
1551 indices.push_back(base + 3);
1552 }
1553 return newMeshFromArrays(pos.data(), nrm.data(), uv.data(), int(pos.size() / 3), indices.data(),
1554 int(indices.size()));
1555}

1557bool Graphics::saveFramePng(const std::string& path) {
1558 if (!screenReadbackEnabled) setScreenReadbackEnabled(true);
1559 std::unique_ptr<eve::image::ImageData> frame;
1560 try {
1561 frame.reset(newImageData());
1562 } catch (...) {
1563 return false; // no presented frame yet
1564 }
1565 if (!frame) return false;
1566 std::unique_ptr<eve::filesystem::FileData> png(
1567 frame->encode(medialoader::FormatHandler::ENCODED_PNG, path.c_str(), false));
1568 if (!png) return false;
1569 std::error_code ec;
1570 std::filesystem::create_directories(std::filesystem::path(path).parent_path(), ec);
1571 std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary);
1572 if (!out.good()) return false;
1573 out.write(static_cast<const char*>(png->getData()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(png->getSize()));
1574 return out.good();
1575}

1636
1637eve::Result<void> Graphics::updateTextureFromImageData(Texture *texture,
1638 image::ImageData *data) {
1639 ensureFileTexturesReady();
1640 if (!texture || !data)
1641 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
1642 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "texture and ImageData must be non-null",
1643 "graphics.updateTextureFromImageData"));
1644 if (data->getFormat() != "RGBA8")
1645 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
1646 eve::DiagnosticCode::Unsupported, "only RGBA8 ImageData is supported",
1647 "graphics.updateTextureFromImageData.format"));
1648 if (!updateTexture(texture, data->getWidth(), data->getHeight(),
1649 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data->getData())))
1650 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
1651 eve::DiagnosticCode::Failed,
1652 "texture is not owned by this backend, dimensions differ, or upload failed",
1653 "graphics.updateTextureFromImageData"));
1654 return eve::Result<void>::success();
1655}

1686
1687void Graphics::ensureFileTexturesReady() {
1688 if (deferredFileTextures_.empty() || realizingFileTextures_) return;
1689 realizingFileTextures_ = true;
1690 StartupStage stage("graphics: realize file textures");
1691 struct Guard {
1692 Graphics *g;
1693 ~Guard() { g->realizingFileTextures_ = false; }
1694 } guard{this};
1695
1696 std::vector<DeferredFileTexture> pending = std::move(deferredFileTextures_);
1697 deferredFileTextures_.clear();
1698
1699 auto restoreUnrealized = [&]() {
1700 for (const auto &item : pending) {
1701 if (item.texture && item.texture->hasDeferredFilePixels())
1702 deferredFileTextures_.push_back(item);
1703 }
1704 };
1705
1706 auto &resources = eve::ResourceManager::getInstance();
1707 for (const auto &item : pending) {
1708 auto waited = resources.waitFor(item.key);
1709 if (!waited.ok()) {
1710 restoreUnrealized();
1711 throw eve::Exception("%s", waited.status().describe().c_str());
1712 }
1713 }
1714
1715 try {
1716 for (const auto &item : pending) {
1717 auto waited = resources.waitFor(item.key);
1718 if (!waited.ok())
1719 throw eve::Exception("%s", waited.status().describe().c_str());
1720 auto *data = dynamic_cast<image::ImageData *>(&waited.value().get());
1721 if (!data || !uploadDeferredFileTexture(item.texture, data))
1722 throw eve::Exception("newTextureFromFile: GPU upload failed '%s'", item.key.c_str());
1723 if (item.texture) item.texture->clearDeferredFilePixels();
1724 }
1725 } catch (...) {
1726 restoreUnrealized();
1727 throw;
1728 }
1729}

1731Texture* Graphics::newTextureFromFileRepeated(const std::string& filename, bool repeatU, bool repeatV) {
1732 if (filename.empty()) throw eve::Exception("newTextureFromFileRepeated: empty filename");
1733 auto* fs = eve::filesystem::Filesystem::create();
1734 std::unique_ptr<eve::filesystem::FileData> fileData(fs->read(filename));
1735 if (!fileData) throw eve::Exception("newTextureFromFileRepeated: failed to read '%s'", filename.c_str());
1736 auto* imgMod = eve::image::Image::create();
1737 std::unique_ptr<eve::image::ImageData> data(imgMod->newImageData(fileData.get()));
1738 return newTextureFromImageData(data.get(), repeatU, repeatV);
1739}
1740
1741Texture* Graphics::newTextureWithSampler(image::ImageData* data, bool repeatU, bool repeatV, bool generateMipmaps,
1742 float maxAnisotropy, const std::string& filter, const std::string& mipmap,
1743 float lodBias) {
1744 TextureCreateInfo info;
1745 info.generateMipmaps = generateMipmaps;
1746 info.sampler.min = TextureSampler::parseFilter(filter);
1747 info.sampler.mag = info.sampler.min;
1748 info.sampler.mipmap = TextureSampler::parseMipmap(mipmap);
1749 if (generateMipmaps && info.sampler.mipmap == MipmapMode::Disabled) info.sampler.mipmap = MipmapMode::Linear;
1750 info.sampler.repeatU = repeatU;
1751 info.sampler.repeatV = repeatV;
1752 info.sampler.maxAnisotropy = maxAnisotropy;
1753 info.sampler.lodBias = lodBias;
1754 return newTextureFromImageData(data, info);
1755}
1756
1757void Graphics::setTextureSampler(Texture* texture, const std::string& filter, const std::string& mipmap,
1758 float maxAnisotropy, float lodBias) {
1759 if (!texture) return;
1760 // Fail fast on typos instead of silently treating an unknown filter as linear.
1761 if (filter != "nearest" && filter != "Nearest" && filter != "NEAREST" &&
1762 filter != "linear" && filter != "Linear" && filter != "LINEAR") {
1763 throw eve::Exception("Graphics::setTextureSampler: unknown filter '%s'", filter.c_str());
1764 }
1765 if (mipmap != "none" && mipmap != "None" && mipmap != "NONE" &&
1766 mipmap != "nearest" && mipmap != "Nearest" && mipmap != "NEAREST" &&
1767 mipmap != "linear" && mipmap != "Linear" && mipmap != "LINEAR") {
1768 throw eve::Exception("Graphics::setTextureSampler: unknown mipmap mode '%s'", mipmap.c_str());
1769 }
1770 TextureSampler s = texture->getSampler();
1771 s.min = TextureSampler::parseFilter(filter);
1772 s.mag = s.min;
1773 s.mipmap = TextureSampler::parseMipmap(mipmap);
1774 s.maxAnisotropy = maxAnisotropy;
1775 s.lodBias = lodBias;
1776 setTextureSampler(texture, s);
1777}

1781Font* Graphics::newFont(font::FontData* data, std::string charset) { return new Font(this, data, std::move(charset)); }
1782
1783void Graphics::print(const std::string& text, float x, float y, const Color& color, float scale) {
1784 if (currentFont == nullptr) {
1785 eve::debug::rtDraw("print", "no-font");
1786 throw eve::Exception("Graphics::print: no font set (call setFont first)");
1787 }
1788 drawText(currentFont, text, x, y, color, scale);
1789}
1790
1791void Graphics::drawText(Font* font, const std::string& text, float x, float y, const Color& color, float scale) {
1792 if (font == nullptr) {
1793 eve::debug::rtDraw("drawText", "no-font");
1794 throw eve::Exception("Graphics::drawText: font must not be null");
1795 }
1796 eve::debug::rtBind("font", "explicit");
1797 eve::debug::rtDraw("drawText", text.empty() ? "" : "text");
1798
1799 eve::font::FontData* data = font->getData();
1800 float penX = x;
1801 float baseline = y + font->getBaseline() * scale;
1802 int prevCodepoint = -1;
1803
1804 size_t i = 0;
1805 while (i < text.size()) {
1806 uint32_t cp = nextCodepointUtf8(text, i);
1807 if (cp == 0) continue;
1808 int code = static_cast<int>(cp);
1809
1810 if (prevCodepoint >= 0) penX += data->getKerning(prevCodepoint, code) * scale;
1811
1812 if (const Font::Glyph* g = font->findGlyph(code)) {
1813 if (g->width > 0 && g->height > 0) {
1814 float gx = penX + static_cast<float>(g->bearingX) * scale;
1815 float gy = baseline - static_cast<float>(g->bearingY) * scale;
1816 drawTexturedRectUV(font->getTexture(), gx, gy, static_cast<float>(g->width) * scale,
1817 static_cast<float>(g->height) * scale, g->u0, g->v0, g->u1, g->v1, color);
1818 }
1819 penX += static_cast<float>(g->advance) * scale;
1820 } else {
1821 // Not pre-rasterized into this Font's atlas — still advance the pen.
1822 penX += static_cast<float>(data->getGlyphAdvance(code)) * scale;
1823 }
1824
1825 prevCodepoint = code;
1826 }
1827}
1828
